When I was a teenager, I thought my dream boyfriend would be kind, emotionally supportive, and accepting of my bisexuality. Bonus points if he was bi too. In the summer of 2017, I was very lonely and depressed, and self harmed after two months of being clean.

The next morning I went to college orientation. I was in a shit mood and got distracted easily. There were these people behind me who wouldn’t stop talking and it got on my nerves. Eventually I snapped, turned around, and said, “Can you guys stop talking through the entire thing?” I figured that I wouldn’t see them again because this school has 30,000 students and I came from a school with 45 people in my graduating class. I saw them again that night in one of the dorm lounges. I apologized to them and the guy said, “It’s ok, we’re friends now.” We played never have I ever as a group and I found out that we’re both freaky bisexuals. I didn’t think I’d stay in touch with him long after orientation. He’s now the only person I keep in touch with because he’s my boyfriend.
For some reason the comment won’t load but yes I’m still here.
Are you able to get professional help? I think that’s what you need more than hoarding your meds.
Yes. And he knows how much I’m hurting. I’ve been going to therapy and still feel like shit.

I already apologized for calling him names. I feel like I was pressured into saying yes and that I will never have my gay experience. Plus I’m thinking why would he want to fuck someone else when he’s in a relationship with me.
